instruction: Create a Sticky Note containing all three distance-based water-intake recommendations from the SELF article, using Microsoft Edge Immersive Reader to read the article. Keep one recommendation per line.
gt_steps: Switch to the SELF hydration article in Microsoft Edge.
With the article active in Microsoft Edge, press `F9` to enter Immersive Reader.

Enter the following text in the note, one recommendation per line:
`Short distance (2 to 5 miles): 12 to 20 ounces via a handheld or belt`
`Medium distance (5 to 10 miles): 20 to 50 ounces (0.5 to 1.5 liters) via a small pack or vest for medium-length runs, hot weather, or adventures with a dog`
`Long distances (10+ miles): 50 to 100 ounces (1.5 to 3 liters) via a larger vest or day pack for longer runs in hot weather, or if there isn't water restock available`
Keep the completed note saved in Sticky Notes.

points: Short distance (2 to 5 miles): 12 to 20 ounces via a handheld or belt
Medium distance (5 to 10 miles): 20 to 50 ounces (0.5 to 1.5 liters) via a small pack or vest for medium-length runs, hot weather, or adventures with a dog

via a larger vest or day pack for longer runs in hot weather
